ns2:section.sectionText: Provides students with an exposure to the real world of real estate through a series of lectures by real estate professionals focused primarily on retail real estate development. A side benefit of the class will be to provide graduating seniors some insights into different career paths to help improve the career choices that they make. REGISTRATION REQUIRES THAT STUDENTS SUBMIT AN APPLICATION FORM AND RESUME. Interested students may either pick up a syllabus and application in 340 Wohlers Hall or e-mail Prof. Cannaday at rcannada@uiuc.edu for both the syllabus and application.
